A full card image re-made by the Players Committee with the mark D-E1 in the lower border (27 January 2024). Its words are the Players Committee's errata, not Decipher's.

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Ref2-L-houjix&outofnowhere-PC-Errata-2024-D-E1-card-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Houjix & Out Of Nowhere (PC Errata 2018 E card)]] (8 July 2018): The game text changes: “&gt;3,” becomes “&gt; 3,”. The whole card is drawn again at 745 × 1039 pixels, with the mark “D-E1” in the lower border in place of the “E”. “LOST:” starts a new line.

The whole 2018 E card image and the whole 2024 D-E1 card image, both scaled to 500 pixels wide; nothing else is edited.
